dedupe_keys.name: unep irp global material flows database

description: Global accounts of raw material extraction, trade and consumption by country. The International Resource Panel page says the Global Material Flows Database covers 1970 to 2024 for more than 200 countries and regions and reports extraction and direct trade of raw materials, indirect trade flows including material footprints, and intensities derived from these, built from public international sources with current material flow accounting methods, to monitor SDG targets 8.4 and 12.2. A technical annex (version of June 2024) describing sources and methods is a free download. Coverage is global. Caveats: the page read does not show the data download route or licence, and values are national totals, not sites. For simulation it gives each country's dependence on extracted and imported materials, to size exposure of industries to supply shocks in mining regions. A related catalogue record is the BGS world mineral statistics.
